import pytest
from rich.console import Console
from rich.text import Text

def test_nerd_font_width() -> None:
    console = Console(file=io.StringIO(), width=10, legacy_windows=True)
    text = Text("\U000f024d")  # Nerd font character for downloads folder
    console.print(text)
    assert console.file.getvalue() == "\U000f024d\n"
